notes.title: "Miss Peacock" Version 1.0 Release & Final Closed Beta Preparation
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
[p align="start"]The closed beta has now reached v1.0, meaning the official launch is just around the corner.
[p align="start"]Currently, we are polishing the game and preparing for the final closed beta test.
[p align="start"]Stay tuned for more updates!
[p align="start"]\[Otter Club Games]
\[September 8, 2025]

notes.title: Miss Peacock Build v0.12.0 Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your support and patience with "Miss Peacock"!

The game is still in the polishing phase. The latest internal version has reached v0.12.0, with further optimizations to the UI, fixes for various bugs reported during the first beta test, and significant improvements to the overall gameplay experience.

Due to the substantial volume of updates, we are currently evaluating whether to conduct a second beta test. If confirmed, we will announce the details in our official community groups and invite both new and returning players to participate.

We deeply appreciate your companionship on this journey.

\[Otter Club Games]
\[June 17, 2025]

notes.title: Miss Peacock：Build v0.9.0 Update Launched
Miss Peacock Beta version test is coming!
notes.notes:
Those who are interested in participating in the internal testing of game Miss Peacock Beta version please fill out the test registration form. 
The name of the people who complete the entire process of the Beta version test will appear on the credit list.
